seed.tagline: An Expo (React Native) app over your backend API.
seed.description: Adds a mobile/ folder with an Expo (React Native, TypeScript, expo-router) app generated from the rulebook: a list, detail, create and edit screen per table, derived values read-only, relationships as links, all talking to the backend's generated API.

replacements.label: App name
replacements.description: The app's display name on the device and its home screen title.

replacements.label: Bundle id
replacements.description: The iOS bundle identifier and Android package name (reverse-DNS).

replacements.label: API base URL
replacements.description: Where the app reaches the backend's generated API.
